source_payload.datasetnotes: Data were digitized from the pollen diagram in Figure 1, von Post (1918). According to the text, the pollen sum included all trees except Corylus, whose percentages were based on the sum of the other types. The raw digitized tree sums, which varied from 94.5-100.5%, were adjusted to sum to 100%. These percentages were multiplied times a pollen sum of 200 to back calculate the counts. The actual pollen sums were not indicated on the pollen diagram or in the text.
